input: Price out solar panel installation for the roof

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The size of the system (kW capacity) directly determines cost, number of panels, and whether it covers partial or full energy needs — this is the single biggest cost driver.
Whether this is for a personal home, a rental property, or a business changes financing options, tax incentives, and who makes the final decision.
Location affects sunlight hours, local utility rates, available rebates, permitting costs, and which installers are accessible — all of which shift the price significantly.
A hard budget ceiling changes whether to pursue quotes, leasing, PPAs, or loans, and how many installers to contact.
Knowing whether the user wants DIY quotes, online estimator tools, or in-person installer visits determines the immediate next action and timeline.
The user may want a rough ballpark number, a detailed comparison of 3+ installers, or a full ROI/payback analysis — these require very different levels of effort.
Priorities like brand quality, fastest installation, maximum savings, or specific equipment (battery storage, panel brand) will filter which quotes and options to pursue.

gold.taskTitle: Price out solar panel roof installation
gold.taskDescription: Research and compare costs for installing solar panels on a residential or commercial roof.

questions.title: What is the approximate size of the roof or system you need?
questions.description: Establish the target system size in kW or the roof square footage available for panels, as this is the primary cost driver.

questions.title: Is this for a home, rental property, or business?
questions.description: Identify who the installation is for, as this affects tax credits, financing options, and decision-making authority.

questions.title: What city or region is the property located in?
questions.description: Location determines local incentives, utility rates, permitting costs, and available installers.

questions.title: Do you have a maximum budget in mind for this project?
questions.description: A budget ceiling shapes whether to explore loans, leases, PPAs, or outright purchase, and how many quotes to gather.

questions.title: Do you want online estimates, or full in-person installer quotes?
questions.description: Determines the immediate next action — using an online solar calculator versus scheduling site visits with local installers.

questions.title: Are you looking for a rough ballpark or a detailed installer comparison?
questions.description: Clarifies the depth of research needed — a quick estimate versus a full multi-quote comparison with ROI and payback analysis.

questions.title: Is battery storage or a specific panel brand a priority for you?
questions.description: Identifies equipment preferences that will filter which products and installers to consider.
